hostedAssistantBrowserVoicePlaywright.assetProof: A local next build/next start server delivered same-origin Worker, WASM, and AudioWorklet URLs in desktop Chromium and Pixel 5 Chromium emulation; exact HTTP probes passed JavaScript/WASM MIME and content-signature checks; AudioWorklet frames were delivered; captured tracks ended; both composer layouts fit without horizontal overflow.
hostedAssistantBrowserVoicePlaywright.boundary: Chromium fake media through native getUserMedia, AudioContext, AudioWorklet, and the production-built hosted Next Assistant path with built @aurora/voice-web Worker/WASM assets and deterministic demo transcript. The mobile lane is Playwright Pixel 5 Chromium emulation. This is Chromium-only automation, not hosted Firefox/WebKit, a physical microphone, an OS permission prompt, a physical Android device, acoustic recognition, or local-browser STT.

hostedBrowserLimitations.firefox: The fake-media hosted app reached listening state but delivered zero AudioWorklet frames; a minimal headless Firefox probe also failed to progress through AudioWorklet module execution, so no hosted Firefox PTT claim is made.
hostedBrowserLimitations.webkit: Linux Playwright WebKit has no supported fake-microphone path in this environment; unsupported launch flags were rejected and are excluded from the accepted gate.

knownCorrectedFailure.cause: non-sensitive occurredAtMs happened to contain a PCM sentinel digit sequence

realMicrophoneValidation.evidence: PulseAudio-on-PipeWire was reachable, but every analog input port was unavailable, direct one-second capture contained only zero samples, and Chromium without fake media exposed no audio input and returned NotFoundError.
